name: pencil
description: A shortened pencil for balanced inline editing.
useCase: Edit an existing item next to other utility actions.
misuse: Use a compose metaphor only when creating a new message.

16.reason: The diagonal body is deliberately shorter than the maximum keyline so edit does not dominate check, x and ellipsis. Text master: 1.5px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 12 × 12 drawing area.

24.reason: The diagonal body is deliberately shorter than the maximum keyline so edit does not dominate check, x and ellipsis. Interface master: 1.75px construction. The complete silhouette is centered within the shared 18 × 18 drawing area.
